record.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VII. Disjoint holes

dossier_meta.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VII. Disjoint holes
dossier_meta.context_text: Esperet's conjecture that every $\chi$-bounded hereditary class is poly-$\chi$-bounded was recently disproved by Briański, Davies and Walczak. This motivates the overarching question of characterising which hereditary classes do have a polynomial binding function.
